newsitem.title: USA: AVIC to acquire business of American Network.
newsitem.headline: AVIC to acquire business of American Network.

text.p: AVIC Group International Inc said Monday it reached agreement to acquire the Chinese private data network business of American Network Technologies Inc.
An AVIC source said the deal, worth about $5 million in cash and mostly stock, is performance driven based on results of the next two years.
The company said the acquisition includes AmNet China, a Beijing-based foreign subsidiary of American Network.
AmNet, a developer and manager of private data networks in China, had revenues of $6.5 million in 1996 and expects substantial increases in 1997, AVIC said.
The company said the acquisition gives it a head start into a growing market that complements its current operations in China.
AVIC said the transaction is expected to close before July 1.
